desc.zh: 从中间剩余回文推导反向字典树与线性回文边界预处理。
desc.en: Derive reversed-trie search and linear palindrome boundaries from the unmatched middle.

complexity: O(S + n + P) expected time; O(S + n) auxiliary space plus O(P) output; S = total characters, n = words, P = pairs

concepts.name: Palindrome pair cancellation
concepts.description: Two leftover-middle cases derive reversed-trie metadata

concepts.name: Linear palindrome boundary flags
concepts.description: Odd/even mirrored radii mark prefix and suffix palindromes
